description_en: Modifies the enabling status of log analysis
description_zh: 修改日志分析启用状态
kebab_example: aliyun sas modify-log-meta-status --log-store aegis-log-login --status disabled --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyLogMetaStatus

parameters.help_en: The request source identifier. Set this parameter to sas
parameters.help_zh: 请求来源标识，固定取值为sas
parameters.name: from

parameters.help_en:
The project name.
You can call the [DescribeLogMeta](~~DescribeLogMeta~~) operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
Project名称。
您可以调用[DescribeLogMeta](~~DescribeLogMeta~~)接口获取该参数
parameters.name: project

parameters.help_en:
The name of the dedicated Logstore where logs are stored.
You can call the [DescribeLogMeta](~~DescribeLogMeta~~) operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
日志存放的专属Logstore名称。
您可以调用[DescribeLogMeta](~~DescribeLogMeta~~)接口获取该参数
parameters.name: log_store

parameters.help_en:
The status to which you want to change the log. Valid values:
enabled: enabled
disabled: disabled
parameters.help_zh:
指定需要修改的日志的状态。取值：
enabled：启用
disabled：禁用
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the member account in the resource directory (Alibaba Cloud account).
Call the [DescribeMonitorAccounts](~~DescribeMonitorAccounts~~) operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
资源目录成员账号ID（阿里云账号）。
调用[DescribeMonitorAccounts](~~DescribeMonitorAccounts~~)接口可以获取该参数
parameters.name: resource_directory_account_id

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request. You can use this ID to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
